刚卖完， $Jager 这波总共撸了  115 BNB ， 消耗手续费 30 BNB 
https://bscscan.com/address/0x69e17ebcb0ba700c3a907500702fb0ebe0e69506
给写“脚本”的哥们分了 34 BNB  
给提供“情报”的哥们分了 23 BNB 
自己也没赚多少。
最大的失误： 开始没研究透这个项目，听别人说了一嘴，耽误了 2 天。如果提前一天，能多领 300 BNB。
后期领的币越来越小。
其实，我们这边“执行力”比较强。 
资金和技术都有， 很多方案能快速落实。
就是缺比较好的投研和情报。
很多机会，先搞的吃肉能撑死你。
比如之前的 $BOOP  @boopdotfun  刚上线。
AEUhbDeLBXeJuY5bhiupdcc9dCcEWKbNRra49GEiLG71
那个时候钱包的策略，非常简单： 
狙击所有蓝V账号发的币 ，后面有买单立刻卖出获利！
这个钱包，我眼看着它，一天撸了 400 个 $SOL
AZrsQxBjZQ9y3vqE9VaL1W5jrFyjYFzW6sx6BeQRf4Ar
另一个钱包，这个方案手动撸了 40 SOL 。
我们执行的慢了，后来的 BOOP 不行了，只能看到卷。
最后，求带 ⬇️ 
很久没有➕ 别人的 Alpha 群了。
希望多加些“执行力人才” 👀 
有没有小群的大佬， 拉拉我，技术+资金我这边都可以。
比较好的信息可以共享，肯定是有偿的。
DM  @AntCaveClub 或者加我微信， 拉我。

后来涨了，又有很多人分享。
赶紧写了一个脚本自动领取。

articles.author: 链求君 🔥
articles.description:
贝莱德比特币交易所交易基金 (ETF) 连续 16 天录得强劲流入，表明投资者对加密货币市场兴趣浓厚且信心十足。
比特币 (BTC) 价格也开始呈现上涨势头，上涨并预示着其价值可能回升。
持续流入 ETF 的资金加上比特币价格的上涨趋势，反映出投资者对加密货币资产未来前景的乐观情绪日益高涨。
创新型投资公司 Metaplanet 增持了 555 枚比特币 (BTC)，价值约 5340 万美元，进一步增强了其加密货币投资组合。

I want to be absolutely clear here.
“We have a domestic inequality problem that people have now confused with a free trade problem.”
The part after the first “problem” is wrong. We have confused unbalanced trade with free trade. FREE trade balances through currency. We have incentivized balance through sale of financial capital (stocks and bonds) and real estate, benefiting capital owners who import foreign labor in the form of goods and experience rising incomes through credit issued to an increasingly debt-burdened wage earners.
I GET the libertarian argument. I was trained at the cathedral of it (Wharton). Everything moves in cycles. Intrusive and abusive government is a symptom of a fraying society.
And to directly address the observation, yes we are a wealthy country (albeit less so on a relative basis than 50 and 100 years ago) and we benefit from trade. It’s not that other countries have “stolen” from us. It’s that we have allowed unbalanced trade to disproportionately benefit a global elite class that is now largely separate and distinct from their fellow countrymen (in both China and the U.S.) @michaelxpettis

I don't see many offering alternatives to the Trump policy agenda with regards to fixing the income inequality but I still see many not understanding the why. This table might help explain. Given the strong correlation between this data and border crossings, it is very clear in showing that illegal immigration and an open border policy has hurt lower and middle income American workers' competitive position in the labor market as well as hampered their wage growth. While this is both pro-growth and disinflationary, the benefits accrue to corporations via higher profits and the wealthy upper class via higher stock prices at the expense of the lower and middle class who suffer wage stagnation and low job growth.
If this strikes a chord with you, I would like to understand why as I have tried to write this as objectively and factual as possible.
